rich2021ActivityMath: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L12 reviews adding decimals using THREE original interactive games: Race to One, Race to One Tenth, and Decimal Race to500. These games produce REAL student-dependent scores, not one seeded official winner.

Activity1 Race to One rolls one number cube each turn, selects that digit as TENTHS or HUNDREDTHS, adds it to previous score, wins on exactly1.00 and forfeits a move if the total would exceed1. Race to One Tenth uses HUNDREDTHS or THOUSANDTHS, target exactly0.1, with the same overshoot rule.

Activity2 Decimal Race to500: spin THREE digits per turn; ODDS may occupy only fractional tenths/hundredths/thousandths and EVENS only whole ones/tens/hundreds. Example source digits2,3,9 allow 2.39 or2.93, then add to prior total; first reaching500 or more wins.

Game execution, student roll choices, place-value strategies and real winner need teacher verification; selected exact choices cover only rules and source warm-up. Previous fictional trial rolls must be clearly marked Edulytiks demo.
